source.note: This report describes the cited UCNS state plus the current repo-owned research plan. Report-only commits are coordination metadata and are not treated as UCNS mathematical evidence. The 2026-08-17 lexical correction deprecates the NGSL lexical-floor premise and its fixed-list closure rule; a Scrabble dictionary is authorized as the replacement lexical source class, with exact edition/source custody still to be pinned.

portfolio_role.summary: Option-preserving multimodal geometric relation-carrier research: preserve relations among heterogeneous objects across scale and representation without collapsing unresolved options, object modalities, or relation topologies into one default.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: UCNS owns its relation-carrier definitions, candidate geometry, provenance, and scoped evidence.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: Consumers pin exact UCNS identities and may surface, measure, cohere, or enact UCNS-preserved relations only within their own authority boundaries.

status.current_claim: UCNS currently supports bounded candidate-scoped, option-preserving multimodal relation representation while preserving unresolved construction choices explicitly. The NGSL lexical-floor premise is DEPRECATED because NGSL is a word list rather than the dictionary semantic source required for this work. A Scrabble dictionary is authorized as the replacement lexical source class. Dictionary definitions and senses will establish source-bound semantic relationships among word gonols as the first lexical deep-recursion layer without an artificial fixed-list closure gate. The intended PTCNA remains downstream of a not-yet-performed UCNS audit of a functioning conventional neural network; no current PTCNA-shaped candidate state satisfies that prerequisite by construction compatibility alone.
status.current_definition: UCNS is option-preserving multimodal geometric relation-carrier research. A UCNS representation preserves relations among heterogeneous objects without requiring those objects to become numerically identical, modality-identical, or topologically identical; completion remains relative to a declared construction boundary.
